body: A TermAl registered run, focused or FULL, pins the Engram source-owner binary (path plus sha256) at the start of the run and verifies it again after the run (src/engram_source_owner.rs:96-106). Replacing engram.exe on that host mid-run makes the after-capture fail with "executable no longer matches its pin", and the run becomes ineligible. Observed on 2026-11-08: Central's Engram install of 0c012df9 at about 01:20:55Z killed Sol-03d4's registered run a231, even though its 23 tests passed. Rule: never install Engram on a host while a registered TermAl run is active there; drain the host's run queue first, like a cargo job. A fresh run after the install pins the new binary, which counts as validation, not a retry.
